descriptionChirho: The proper name זִיף referring to: (1) a town in the hill country of Judah (Josh 15:55) where David hid from Saul (1 Sam 23:14-15; 26:2), and its associated wilderness; (2) a town in the Negeb of Judah (Josh 15:24); (3) a descendant of Caleb (1 Chr 2:42). All 10 occurrences use this name with or without the conjunction waw ('and Ziph'). Translated as English 'Ziph,' Spanish 'Zif,' Hindi 'Jif' (जीफ), Arabic 'Zif' (زيفَ), Korean 'Jip' (집), Swahili 'Zifu.' The conjunction-prefixed form is syntactically conditioned, not a distinct sense.
